title: Meta acquires Conductor, which lets developers run multiple AI coding agents in parallel; CEO Charlie Holtz says the team will join Meta Superintelligence Labs (Madison Mills/Axios)
summary: Madison Mills / Axios: Meta acquires Conductor, which lets developers run multiple AI coding agents in parallel; CEO Charlie Holtz says the team will join Meta Superintelligence Labs — Meta has acquired Conductor, an AI coding startup that lets software engineers manage multiple coding agents simultaneously …
